messages:
Maria: FYI — deploying the sample-app to Cloudflare Workers and it's blowing up in prod. miniflare local run is fine, but prod fails with `ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined` and TS errors about `node:buffer`. stacktrace points at some encoding helper in the SDK.

Kevin: ouch. CF runtime has no Node builtins. do you have the repro or the failing bundle? can you paste the err/logs?

Maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/actions/runs/12345 — here's the action log snippet: `ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined at encode (dist/encoder.js:12:7)`. TS also shows imports like `import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer'` in some helpers.

Anne: this is the classic edge vs node split. quick hack: add a tiny shim at the worker entry: `import { Buffer } from 'buffer'; globalThis.Buffer = globalThis.Buffer ?? Buffer;` but that's only if your bundler includes `buffer` polyfill. CF won't magically provide node modules.

Jordan: snippet that worked for me with Wrangler + esbuild: 
```js
// worker-entry.mjs
import { Buffer } from 'buffer';
if (!globalThis.Buffer) globalThis.Buffer = Buffer;
import { handleRequest } from './dist/edge/index.mjs';
addEventListener('fetch', e => e.respondWith(handleRequest(e.request)));
```
Note: you may need to alias `node:buffer` -> `buffer` in the bundler resolver.

Tyler: TS typing pain here too. `node:` imports break Deno/Workers typings and cause `Could not find a declaration file for module 'node:buffer'` in some setups. Our SDK should provide two entrypoints (node vs edge) and avoid `node:` prefix in shared helpers. adding separate `types` per export would help.

Maria: agreed — users hit this during onboarding and it feels bad. miniflare hides the problem because it shims. We should document the CF caveats in the sample-app README (and show the shim snippet).

Anne: proposed action items: 1) add a short README note in sample-apps (CF runtime gotchas + quick shim), 2) open an SDK issue to remove `node:` imports from shared helpers and add an `edge` entrypoint, 3) prototype a tiny `edge-shim` initializer in the sdk repo that patches Buffer / subtle crypto if missing. I'll pick 2 + 3.

Kevin: I'll take 1 — add README + an example `wrangler.toml` / esbuild alias entry and a short code sample showing the `buffer` import. Also will ping packaging to consider `exports` + `browser` fields for an edge build.

devex-bot: Anne opened issue #234 in repo "avoid node: imports in sdk + add edge entrypoint" <https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/234> :white_check_mark:

Maria: sweet. thanks team :raised_hands: — can we also add a tiny note about `crypto.subtle` differences and `globalThis.fetch` expectations? CF's fetch is standard but some libs expect `node:crypto` sync APIs.

Anne: good call. I'll add crypto notes to the issue. we'll keep the shim minimal and opt-in so hosted users aren't affected.

Kevin: PR for README in flight, will link here when ready. :rocket:
